title: Usage Relief for Groom Club Monthly Members Who Have Visited
content:
**Groom Club Monthly — usage relief, Tailwise Grooming Salon.** A member who has used the club receives a usage relief on the early termination fee.

The usage relief on the early termination fee follows the completed visits recorded on the club: at least 4 give 20 percent, at least 2 but fewer than 4 give 10 percent, and fewer give none.

| Completed visits recorded on the club | Usage relief |
|---|---|
| 4 or more | 20 percent |
| 2 or 3 | 10 percent |
| 0 or 1 | none |

Completed visits are the checked-out visits in the salon history of the club since it was joined; redos, no-shows, forfeited visits and cancellations are not completed visits.

**Applying it.** The usage relief reduces the early termination fee once and does not touch club late-cancellation charges. Where the early termination fee carries more than one percentage relief, the reliefs are first added into one relief percentage, never above 100 percent, and that combined percentage reduces the early termination fee once; the reliefs do not act one after the other.

**Input, judgement, output (hypothetical early termination fee of 25.00 before relief, no other relief)**

| Completed visits | Relief | Fee after relief |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | none | 25.00 |
| 2 | 10 percent | 22.50 |
| 3 | 10 percent | 22.50 |
| 4 | 20 percent | 20.00 |
